name: Sprint City
description:
About This Game

Sprint City is a competitive 2D racing platformer from the creators of SpeedRunners, made for quick and easy fun with your friends!

Race, jump, and grapple through a city built around speed while battling your friends for the fastest times. Getting your friends into the game is effortless: invite up to 7 friends to play for free directly through their browser.

In Clockout, Sprint City’s signature multiplayer mode, time is your health. Finish ahead to drain your opponents’ clocks and survive longer. The last runner with time left wins.

Sprint City is built for quick sessions, rematches, and “just one more game” with friends.

Key Features

  • Fast multiplayer races for up to 8 players

  • Free browser-based friend invites

  • Clockout Game mode: high-pressure elimination races

  • Solo Time Trials & Daily Challenges

  • Global Leaderboards

  • Character customization

Master the movement. Find the shortcuts. Survive the clock.
short_desc: Looking for something fast you can play with friends right now? Sprint City is a 2D racing platformer that lets up to 7 players join the fun for free via browser. Instant fun!
